title: Weekend Day Multipliers for ClearPath After-Hours Remote Labor
content:
The after-hours day multiplier of the after-hours remote amount of a ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket reads the day of the week of the resolution, as recorded on the ticket's resolution milestone:

| Day of the week of the resolution | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Sunday | the tier's after-hours multiplier plus 0.5 |
| Saturday | the tier's after-hours multiplier plus 0.25 |
| any other day | the tier's after-hours multiplier |

**Hypothetical applications.** On a tier whose after-hours multiplier is 1.5: a ticket resolved on a Sunday takes 2.0, on a Saturday 1.75, on a Friday night 1.5. On a tier whose multiplier is 2.0: Sunday 2.5, Saturday 2.25. A ticket resolved on Sunday 2026-01-04 takes the Sunday multiplier; one resolved on Monday 2026-01-05 takes the tier's multiplier.
